1475311.name: Allure of Darkness
1475311.desc: Draw 2 cards, then banish 1 DARK monster from your hand, or, if you do not have any in your hand, send your entire hand to the GY.

2009101.name: Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind
2009101.desc: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Gale the Whirlwind", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). Once per turn: You can target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls; that target's ATK and DEF become half its current ATK and DEF.

5318639.name: Mystical Space Typhoon
5318639.desc: Target 1 Spell/Trap on the field; destroy that target.

7391448.name: Goyo Guardian
7391448.desc:
1 EARTH Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon that monster to your field in Defense Position.

14087893.name: Book of Moon
14087893.desc: Target 1 face-up monster on the field; change that target to face-down Defense Position.

19613556.name: Heavy Storm
19613556.desc: Destroy all Spell and Trap Cards on the field.

22835145.name: Blackwing - Blizzard the Far North
22835145.desc: Cannot be Special Summoned. When this card is Normal Summoned: You can target 1 Level 4 or lower "Blackwing" monster in your Graveyard; Special Summon that target in Defense Position.

23693634.name: Colossal Fighter
23693634.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
This card gains 100 ATK for every Warrior-Type monster in any Graveyard. When this card is destroyed by battle and sent to the Graveyard: You can target 1 Warrior-Type monster in either Graveyard; Special Summon that target.

24508238.name: D.D. Crow
24508238.desc: (Quick Effect): You can discard this card to the GY, then target 1 card in your opponent's GY; banish that target.

26593852.name: Ally of Justice Catastor
26593852.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
At the start of the Damage Step, if this card battles a face-up non-DARK monster: Destroy that monster.

29401950.name: Bottomless Trap Hole
29401950.desc: When your opponent Summons a monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK: Destroy that monster(s) with 1500 or more ATK, and if you do, banish it.

30461781.name: Legacy of Yata-Garasu
30461781.desc:
Activate 1 of these effects:
● Draw 1 card.
● Activate only if your opponent controls a face-up Spirit monster. Draw 2 cards.

33236860.name: Blackwing - Silverwind the Ascendant
33236860.desc:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 2 or more non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can target up to 2 face-up monsters on the field with DEF lower than this card's ATK; destroy those targets. You cannot conduct your Battle Phase the turn you activate this effect. During each of your opponent's turns, the first "Blackwing" monster you control that would be destroyed by battle, is not destroyed.

34717238.name: Pulling the Rug
34717238.desc: Negate the activation and effect of an Effect Monster whose effect activated when a monster was Normal Summoned (even itself), and destroy that Effect Monster.

35027493.name: Deck Devastation Virus
35027493.desc: Tribute 1 DARK monster with 2000 or more ATK; look at your opponent's hand, all monsters they control, and all cards they draw until the end of their 3rd turn after this card's activation, and destroy all those monsters with 1500 or less ATK.

37520316.name: Mind Control
37520316.desc: Target 1 monster your opponent controls; until the End Phase, take control of that target, but it cannot declare an attack or be Tributed.

41420027.name: Solemn Judgment
41420027.desc: When a monster(s) would be Summoned, OR a Spell/Trap Card is activated: Pay half your LP; negate the Summon or activation, and if you do, destroy that card.

42009836.name: Fossil Dyna Pachycephalo
42009836.desc: If this card is flipped face-up: Destroy all Special Summoned monsters on the field. Neither player can Special Summon monsters.

43385557.name: Magical Android
43385557.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
During each of your End Phases: Gain 600 LP for each Psychic-Type monster you currently control.

44095762.name: Mirror Force
44095762.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

44508094.name: Stardust Dragon
44508094.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When a card or effect is activated that would destroy a card(s) on the field (Quick Effect): You can Tribute this card; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it. During the End Phase, if this effect was activated this turn (and was not negated): You can Special Summon this card from your GY.

49003716.name: Blackwing - Bora the Spear
49003716.desc: If you control a "Blackwing" monster other than "Blackwing - Bora the Spear", you can Special Summon this card (from your hand). If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage.

50321796.name: Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier
50321796.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
You can discard any number of cards to the GY, then target the same number of cards your opponent controls; return those cards to the hand. You can only use this effect of "Brionac, Dragon of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

53341729.name: Light-Imprisoning Mirror
53341729.desc: Negate all LIGHT monster effects activated on the field or in the Graveyard.

53567095.name: Icarus Attack
53567095.desc: Tribute 1 Winged Beast-Type monster, then target 2 cards on the field; destroy them.

58120309.name: Starlight Road
58120309.desc: When a card or effect is activated that would destroy 2 or more cards you control: Negate the effect, and if you do, destroy that card, then you can Special Summon 1 "Stardust Dragon" from your Extra Deck.

58820853.name: Blackwing - Shura the Blue Flame
58820853.desc: When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: You can Special Summon 1 "Blackwing" monster with 1500 or less ATK from your Deck, but its effects are negated.

64697231.name: Trap Dustshoot
64697231.desc: Activate only if your opponent has 4 or more cards in their hand. Look at your opponent's hand, select 1 Monster Card in it, and return that card to its owner's Deck.

65192027.name: Dark Armed Dragon
65192027.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 3 DARK monsters in your GY. You can banish 1 DARK monster from your GY, then target 1 card on the field; destroy that target.

69031175.name: Blackwing Armor Master
69031175.desc:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
Cannot be destroyed by battle, and you take no battle damage from attacks involving this card. At the end of the Damage Step, if this card attacked a monster: You can place 1 Wedge Counter on that monster (max. 1). You can remove all Wedge Counters from your opponent's monsters; the ATK and DEF of those monsters that had Wedge Counters become 0 until the end of this turn.

69162969.name: Lightning Vortex
69162969.desc: Discard 1 card; destroy all face-up monsters your opponent controls.

70095154.name: Cyber Dragon
70095154.desc: If only your opponent controls a monster, you can Special Summon this card (from your hand).

70342110.name: Dimensional Prison
70342110.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Target that attacking monster; banish that target.

70780151.name: Thought Ruler Archfiend
70780151.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card destroys a monster by battle and sends it to the Graveyard: Gain LP equal to that monster's original ATK in the Graveyard. During either player's turn, when a Spell/Trap Card is activated that targets exactly 1 Psychic-Type monster (and no other cards): You can pay 1000 LP; negate the activation, and if you do, destroy it.

70902743.name: Red Dragon Archfiend
70902743.desc:
1 Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
After damage calculation, if this card attacks a Defense Position monster your opponent controls: Destroy all Defense Position monsters your opponent controls. During your End Phase: Destroy all other monsters you control that did not declare an attack this turn. This card must be face-up on the field to activate and to resolve this effect.

71044499.name: Nobleman of Crossout
71044499.desc: Target 1 face-down monster on the field; destroy that target, and if you do, banish it, then, if it was a Flip monster, each player reveals their Main Deck, then banishes all cards from it with that monster's name.

71564252.name: Thunder King Rai-Oh
71564252.desc: Neither player can add cards from their Deck to their hand except by drawing them. During either player's turn, when your opponent would Special Summon exactly 1 monster: You can send this face-up card to the Graveyard; negate the Special Summon, and if you do, destroy it.

72714392.name: Blackwing - Vayu the Emblem of Honor
72714392.desc: This face-up card on the field cannot be used as a Synchro Material. If this card is in the Graveyard: You can target 1 non-Tuner "Blackwing" monster in your Graveyard; banish both this card and that target, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Blackwing" Synchro Monster from your Extra Deck whose Level equals the total Levels of the banished monsters, but its effects are negated.

73580471.name: Black Rose Dragon
73580471.desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuner monsters
When this card is Synchro Summoned: You can destroy all cards on the field. Once per turn: You can banish 1 Plant monster from your GY, then target 1 Defense Position monster your opponent controls; change that target to face-up Attack Position, and if you do, its ATK becomes 0 until the end of this turn.

75498415.name: Blackwing - Sirocco the Dawn
75498415.desc: If your opponent controls a monster and you control no monsters, you can Normal Summon/Set this card without Tributing. Once per turn, during your Main Phase 1: You can target 1 "Blackwing" monster you control; until the end of this turn, it gains ATK equal to the total ATK of all "Blackwing" monsters currently on the field, except itself. Monsters other than the targeted monster cannot attack during the turn you activate this effect.

76913983.name: Blackwing Armed Wing
76913983.desc:
1 "Blackwing" Tuner + 1 or more non-Tuner monsters
If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, it gains 500 ATK during the Damage Step only, also inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

79229522.name: Chimeratech Fortress Dragon
79229522.desc:
"Cyber Dragon" + 1+ Machine monsters
Cannot be used as Fusion Material. Must first be Special Summoned (from your Extra Deck) by sending the above cards from either field to the GY. (You do not use "Polymerization".) The original ATK of this card becomes 1000 x the number of Fusion Materials used for its Special Summon.

85215458.name: Blackwing - Kalut the Moon Shadow
85215458.desc: During either player's Damage Step, when a "Blackwing" monster you control is attacking or being attacked: You can send this card from your hand to the Graveyard; that monster gains 1400 ATK until the end of this turn.

87910978.name: Brain Control
87910978.desc: Pay 800 LP, then target 1 face-up monster your opponent controls that can be Normal Summoned/Set; take control of that target until the End Phase.

91351370.name: Black Whirlwind
91351370.desc: When a "Blackwing" monster is Normal Summoned to your field: You can add 1 "Blackwing" monster from your Deck to your hand with less ATK than that monster.
